feature_name: Custom subject alternative name for Cloud SQL instances
summary: Custom subject alternative names let Cloud SQL instances use custom DNS names for connections when configured with customer-managed CAS CA.
extended_definition: Custom subject alternative names let Cloud SQL instances use custom DNS names for connections when configured with customer-managed CAS CA.

Custom SAN Add a custom subject alternative name (SAN) --custom-subject-alternative-names= DNS NAMES If you want to use a custom DNS name to connect to a Cloud SQL instance instead of using an IP address, then configure the custom subject alternative name (SAN) setting while creating the instance.
